title: Open WebUI lets anyone in (open signup or no authentication)
summary: This Open WebUI instance reports from its public config that signup is open, or that authentication is turned off entirely.  Either way a stranger who can reach it can use the AI, which runs on the organization's model keys or hardware, and keep an account as a foothold.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known and the config response is told apart from a soft 404.
confirm.differential: status == 200 and body_contains("enable_login_form") and body_contains("enable_signup") and (body_contains("\"auth\":false") or body_contains("\"enable_signup\":true")) and body_differs(control)

reproduce: curl -sk 'https://host/api/config' and read the JSON features: enable_login_form and enable_signup confirm it is Open WebUI.  "auth":false means authentication is off; "enable_signup":true means anyone can register.  Either way the instance is open.
remediate: Turn signup off (ENABLE_SIGNUP false, or Enable New Sign Ups in the admin panel) and keep authentication on (WEBUI_AUTH true).  Put the instance behind single sign on or the gateway so only staff reach it, and rotate the model keys if strangers may have used them.
